{{Youmay|the weather phenomenon|the comic of the [[Sandstorm (comic story)|same name]], or other [[Sandstorm (disambiguation)|uses of the word]]}}
[[File:WorkYouInfernalMachine_EtU.png|thumb|right|250px|An individual trying to repair a machine while undergoing a sandstorm]]
{{Quote|You'll never reach the outskirts in time. Sandstorms are very, very dangerous.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
A '''sandstorm''', also called a '''sandwhirl''' or '''dust storm''' was a dangerous type of storm that occurred on [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. They consisted of extremely high winds that would carry sand making visibility and breathing extremely difficult. Sandstorms on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sometimes manifested as a moving wall of sand and grit.

The [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of Tatooine referred to sandstorms as the "Teeth Of The Wind."<ref name="CCG-Sandwhirl">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Sandwhirl (Dark)}}</ref>
